blurb:
Loafer is a tiny tuxedo kitten with a very specific policy about meeting new people: he's going to watch you from across the room first, figure out if you're worth his time, and then slowly, on his own schedule, decide you're actually pretty great. His foster mom describes him and his siblings as "a great group of kittens," and Loafer is the curious one. He wants to know everything that's going on. He just wants to learn about it from a safe spot.

Once he warms up, you get a playful, adventurous little guy who loves chasing toys, wrestling with his siblings, and climbing anything he can get his paws on. His foster home also has a ferret, which Loafer apparently takes completely in stride. So if your house is a little chaotic, he's probably going to fit right in.

He does best with gentle kids who won't rush him, and he'd likely love having another cat around. He's litter trained, microchipped, and up to date on his shots. Mostly Mutts is in Kennesaw. You can visit in person or check out his profile at mostlymutts.org to get the process started. Adoption fee is $175.
shelter_hours: Please check mostlymutts.org for current visiting hours
scoring_notes:
• Playful, curious tuxedo kitten with broad household compatibility including chaos, kids, and other pets
• Relatable "slow-to-warm" personality gives readers an endearing hook without red flags
• Recent foster placement suggests a short wait; lower urgency than longer-term candidates
